description:
Merged anddea/revanced-patches@dev (89104d55b, v4.4.0-dev.5).

## Features

### YouTube
- **Built-in downloader, subtitles:** Choose native subtitle languages and SRT or VTT for playlist downloads. A subtitle failure does not stop a video; the batch summary reports saved, skipped and rate-limited tracks.
- **Built-in downloader, SponsorBlock:** Save SponsorBlock segments with single or playlist downloads and choose the categories below the subtitle row. The built-in player follows your category behavior, including background audio auto-skips and a manual skip button, without cutting the media file.
- **Built-in downloader, playlist picker:** Select playlist items before queuing them, with thumbnails, durations and an individual video height cap or audio-only choice. Already-downloaded items start unchecked, and the batch keeps its global quality, subtitle and SponsorBlock choices.
- **Captions:** New Captions patch (secondary caption language, caption scale, stable caption blocks) from upstream.
- **Translate live chat:** Live chat translation with provider, language, exclusion, style and colour settings from upstream.
- **Download post images:** A download action for community post images from upstream.
- **Unlock queue:** The video queue unlock option from upstream (YouTube 20.21 or later).
- **Navigation bar:** Navigation bar style option, a Watch later navigation item and a reorderable navigation bar from upstream. The hide switches of single navigation buttons are replaced by the navigation bar order setting.
- **Copy text:** New select text option.
- **Search comments:** Uses the upstream implementation; the setting stays off by default under Player.
- **Settings:** New settings indicator and a page padding fix from upstream.

### YouTube Music
- **Lyrics:** The upstream lyrics rework (line scale, centering, providers, miniplayer lyrics options).

### Both
- **Translations:** Strings of the fork and upstream in all languages.

## Bug Fixes
- **YouTube, built-in downloader:** The complete footer stays visible in landscape and at larger font sizes, including the playlist picker. The subtitle row has a CC icon and the SponsorBlock toggle has its shield icon. A dismissed picker ignores late loading results, also after a font size change.
- **YouTube Music, track crossfade:** Repeat-one detection works again.
- **Visual preferences icons:** Icons for all new settings.

## Compatibility
- YouTube: **21.39.525, 21.13.164, 20.05.46**.
- YouTube Music: **9.40.51, 9.15.51, 8.30.54**.

Not device-verified: the playlist sheet in landscape, a re-seek into a skip-once segment, the background-audio skip, Translate live chat, and the Music translate/romanize buttons.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/lavinhoque33/revanced-patches/compare/v1.29.1...v1.30.0)
